question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.**

After the teacher chose groups, John and Sara (was selected as partners for project), yet Sarah did most of the work.

options.text: have selected as a partners for a project
were selected as partners for a project
has selected as a partner for a project
had selected as partners for project

solution:
The correct answer is **"were selected as partners for a project."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is plural **(John and Sara)**, so the correct verb form is **"were selected"** instead of** "was selected."**
 
• **"Have selected" (Option 1)** is incorrect because it uses the present perfect tense, which doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Has selected" (Option 3)** is incorrect because it uses the singular verb form "has" instead of the plural "were."
 
• **"Had selected" (Option 4)** is incorrect because it uses the past perfect tense, which suggests that the selection happened before some other past event (e.g. "After the teacher had chosen groups, John and Sara had been selected as partners for the project").
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *After the teacher chose groups, John and Sara **were selected as partners for a project**__, yet Sarah did most of the work. *
